forecast.basis: Both rosters as they stand entering Monday (your streaming spot included), each team starting its best players every day. Next week's streaming is not counted.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.comment: Haliburton (hamstring) is expected to miss at least two more weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Evan Mobley
injuries.comment: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.
